reference.title: Scenario 3 — Hyperlink with non-descriptive display text
reference.shortdesc: Consider an <a> element where the author has used non-descriptive display text such as "click

section.p: Consider an <a> element where the author has used non-descriptive display text such as "click here", "here", or a bare URL as the link's visible label, rather than a phrase that describes the destination.

entry.codeblock: Click here for the full API reference.
See click here for the full API reference.

section.p: Result: The hyperlink is converted correctly into a DITA <xref> element with display text preserved.
section.note: Use descriptive hyperlink text such as "API reference" or "release notes" instead of "click here" or raw URLs. Non-descriptive link text reduces accessibility and makes DITA output harder to navigate.
